content.text: Now I'll create checksums for the source file and then create the transformation script:

input.command: cd /mnt/user-data/outputs && sha256sum met_inventory_source.tsv > met_inventory_source.sha256 && md5sum met_inventory_source.tsv > met_inventory_source.md5 && cat met_inventory_source.sha256 met_inventory_source.md5
input.description: Generate SHA256 and MD5 checksums for the source file
